production-deployment/deployment-basics.summary: Always-on hosting via Render or AWS; Git-based deploy; environment secrets; health endpoint.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
**Render:** connect repository, set start command, configure environment variables, deploy, verify URL.

**AWS (when required):** App Runner or Elastic Beanstalk for FastAPI; S3/CloudFront or equivalent for static frontend; RDS if database is required; Secrets Manager or parameter store for credentials; single region documented.

**Common rules:** no secrets in Git; `/health` endpoint; test Ask IT from a network outside your laptop.


**Customer for Stages 3–9: a retail company (HQ and stores)**

- Approximately **50 employees** across stores and head office.
- IT receives **100 messages per week**; many repeat password, Wi‑Fi, VPN, and device questions.
- Answers exist in **~15 FAQ documents** (PDF or Word). Staff rarely read them.
- **IT lead (sponsor)** wants an internal **Ask IT** page: typed question, cited answer from FAQs, or a clear escalation to IT.
- One **restricted FAQ** (“Admin-only IT notes”) must not appear in answers for standard staff. Only **admin** role may retrieve content from that source.
- **Phase 1 scope:** FAQ assistant only—not a full ticketing or HR system.

sections.heading: Template
sections.body:
```
PRODUCTION CHECKLIST
[ ] Secrets in host env only
[ ] /health returns OK
[ ] Public URL tested
[ ] One FAQ question succeeds
```

production-deployment/observability-trac.summary: Request logs, error counts, and feedback records for the IT lead.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Log timestamp, outcome, and duration per ask request (avoid logging secrets or full API keys). Retain negative feedback with question, answer, and source for FAQ updates. Use host log dashboard (Render or AWS CloudWatch).

sections.heading: Template
sections.body:
```
INCIDENT LOOKUP
1. Open host logs
2. Match time window
3. Cross-check feedback file
4. Reproduce locally
```

production-deployment/reliability-cost-i.summary: LLM timeout with friendly message; monitor provider spend during pilot.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Set request timeout (e.g. 30s). On failure, show a neutral message and IT contact—never raw stack traces. Review provider usage weekly during early production.

production-deployment/deploy-with-tracin.summary: Promote POC to production posture on Render or AWS; verify URL and logs.

sections.heading: Procedure
sections.body:
1. Deploy with production env vars.
2. Verify /health and Ask IT from external network.
3. Capture log screenshot after successful and failed request.

production-deployment/runbook-incident-d.summary: One-page runbook; partner simulates bad API key and recovers using runbook only.

production-deployment/poc-to-production.summary: Checklist before all staff use Ask IT daily.

sections.heading: Example: Retail case
sections.body: "Confirm production URL, secrets, role enforcement, runbook, IT lead review of negative feedback, FAQ ownership, and regression after any FAQ update."

checkpointQuestions: Why rerun regression after FAQ edits?
